paper_title: Dark Matter Axion Search with HAYSTAC Phase II
notes: HAYSTAC Phase IIc/d axion haloscope search. Limits reported as multiples of KSVZ: |g_gamma|>=2.75x KSVZ over 17.28-18.44 ueV (Phase IId) and >=2.96x KSVZ over 18.71-19.46 ueV (Phase IIc), 90% CL. Combined Phase II: 2.86x KSVZ over 16.96-19.46 ueV. Absolute g_agamma values are approximate conversions from KSVZ units (g_aGG^KSVZ ~ 2.1e-16 x m_a[ueV] GeV^-1); original paper reports relative coupling g_gamma/g_gamma^KSVZ. Local DM density rho_a=0.45 GeV/cm^3. Mode crossings 17.89-18.08 and 18.13-18.18 ueV excluded from analysis.
